info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Loan By Loan Id-spec
info.description: The Loan Replacement API enables users to modify an existing loan identified by a unique loan ID. This operation is crucial for financial institutions looking to adjust loan details, such as updating terms, interest rates, or other key attributes without losing the integrity of the existing loan record. Common users of this API include loan officers, customer service representatives, and financial software systems that require loan management functionalities. By using this endpoint, organizations can ensure their loan data remains accurate and up-to-date.

put.description: Updates the details of a specific loan identified by its ID. This operation allows for modification of various loan attributes to ensure the loan information remains accurate and up-to-date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. Please ensure that all required fields are included according to the specified schema.
